description.p: AAE emulates vector arcade hardware with a beam-accurate renderer, and a number of raster titles alongside it.

Adding your own ROMs and artwork: put them in the AAE folder in your home directory, which is created the first time AAE runs. On SteamOS that is /home/deck/AAE/roms and /home/deck/AAE/artwork. A file you add there wins over a bundled one of the same name, and the folder is left alone if the app is uninstalled with --delete-data, so a collection is never lost to a settings reset.

Audio release. Looped samples now fade to silence when they stop instead of cutting off mid-waveform, which removes the click at the end of the thrust sounds in Asteroids, Asteroids Deluxe, Zektor, Space Fury and Solar Quest. Lunar Lander's thrust gains a sub-bass layer so it reaches a subwoofer.
Also in this release: a 6800/6802/6808 CPU core and an MC6821 PIA, start-button lamps for Galaxian and Food Fight, and accuracy fixes across the driver set.
First Linux package. X11/GLX renderer, ALSA audio, and evdev input with per-device keyboard, mouse and gamepad routing.
